primaryChecks.text: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.
primaryChecks.previousContext: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.
primaryChecks.nextContext: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
